# Blender Python helpers (generated by `scripts/workflow/helper_index.py` — do not edit by hand)

Public functions and classes in `scripts/blender/`, by package. Use these before writing node
plumbing yourself. For a signature, read the module's file under `scripts/blender/` (package path = folders);
its docstrings explain each helper, and `references/` explain the methods. `core.archviz` re-exports
the everyday helpers (import, UVs, camera, HDRI, render set-up, assets).

## `core`

- `assets`: `set_project`, `project_root`, `library`, `read_meta`, `write_meta` — The project's asset library: which folder holds library/, and the meta.json of each asset.
- `material_map`: `apply_material_map` — Material map: assign a material to each mesh by the nearest collection that names one.
- `project_paths`: `is_study`, `legacy_studies`, `find_project` — Which folder's library/ a script reads and writes assets in (no bpy: also used by host tools).
- `uv`: `directional_uv`, `box_uv`, `height_span_uv` — UV projections for archviz materials: real-world box, directional (grain follows one axis), and the once-per-object span set.

## `effects`

- `anisotropy`: `anisotropy` — Directional microfacet roughness shared by reflective and transmissive materials.
- `variation_macro_tone`: `macro_tone` — World-space macro tone with independently switched albedo and roughness outputs.
- `variation_per_unit_shading`: `unit_key`, `set_unit_keys`, `unit_values`, `random_tone_material` — Unit keys and independently hashed material variations.
- `variation_tiling`: `lookup_offsets`, `randomized_vectors`, `anti_tile` — Shared offset lookups for image maps, with world-space blending.

## `effects.wear`

- `chipping`: `chip_exposed_mask`, `chip_under_layer`, `dice`, `chip_field`, `rejoin`, `GrainBreaks`, `edge_wear_group`, `add_edge_wear`, `flaked_paint_masks`, `chipping_field` — Geometry chips, flaked coating fields and verified bare-substrate scans.
- `concrete_shading`: `weathered_concrete`, `fresh_concrete_under` — Concrete edge shading and fresh-break material from clean distance and chip fields.
- `crack_ribbon`: `crack_polylines`, `crooked_ribbon_masks` — Compact Cycles crack masks from seeded polylines; avoids expanding every segment into SVM.
- `cracks`: `crack_masks`, `add_cracks`, `apply_crack_masks` — Cracks on a concrete wall: shrinkage cracks from the corners of openings, patchy map-cracking over the rest, a dark core, a grime halo and a shallow groove.
- `decal_atlas`: `StampAtlas`, `build_stamp_atlas` — Pack chosen decal colour and opacity maps without changing their physical aspect ratios.
- `decal_stamps`: `StampSource`, `stamps_field`, `scatter_stamps`, `deposit_stamps` — Neighbour-aware, nonperiodic decal placement in metre-space surface coordinates.
- `default_sources`: `report_missing`, `default_field` — Per-layer source choices and local default assets; missing-id logs are deduplicated per process.
- `dirt`: `edge_dirt_masks`, `corner_dirt_masks`, `dust_surface`, `add_corner_dirt`, `grunge`, `grunge_field` — Dust build-up and bordered grunge patterns.
- `edge_cracks`: `edge_crack_edges`, `add_edge_cracks` — Sparse short cracks running inward from clean outside edges.
- `edge_profile`: `edge_vertex_join` — Shared distance falloffs and noise context for edge line and dust.
- `hybrid_sources`: `HybridSource`, `hybrid_field` — One hybrid definition: procedural region multiplied by a full-range stochastic scan interior.
- `image_masks`: `mask_dimensions_m`, `MaskSource`, `image_mask`, `mask_field`, `asset_mask`, `asset_maps`, `scan_size_m`, `surface_coordinates` — Canonical grayscale image loader for surface-wear masks.
- `layer_names`: `canonical_layer` — Canonical wear layer names and their deprecated input alias.
- `leak_field`: `leak_field_group`, `add_leak_field` — Leak field: per point, how far below the first surface straight above it (a raycast up from just inside the wall) -> `leak_d` and `leak_ok`.
- `mask_views`: `mask_material` — Edge masks as an emission view: one edge-detection method at a time, for side-by-side comparison (pointiness, inside ambient occlusion, bevel normal, the GN edge distance, the chip mask, damage).
- `procedural_patterns`: `procedural_field` — Dispatch procedural patterns to their mechanism owners.
- `scan_sampling`: `stochastic_mask` — Shared stochastic scan sampling through the canonical loader and offset generator.
- `scratches`: `scratches_field`, `scratch_hybrid` — Crossing procedural scratches and their held legacy scan modulation.
- `water_marks`: `add_runoff`, `deposit_profile`, `deposit_distance`, `irregular_deposits`, `dried_marks_field` — Runoff: vertical streaks below drip edges, grunge patches and soil splash, all into the grime mask.
- `wear`: `WearLayer`, `wear_factor`, `apply_surface_wear` — Independent wear layers sharing procedural and grayscale-image factor inputs.
- `wear_locations`: `WearExtent`, `face_z`, `patch_extent`, `location_extent`, `edge_field`, `set_round_radius`, `round_shader`, `round_geometry`, `switch_rounding` — Clean edge fields, scene rounding and location extents for wear.

## `materials.tile`

- `damage_build`: `damage_group`
- `damage_shading`: `damage_shaders`
- `layout_build`: `layout_group`
- `layout_instance`: `add_layout`
- `layout_reference`: `reference`
- `tile_albedo`: `desaturate`, `face_tone`, `albedo`, `dust` — Tile colour: face and grout albedo, per-tile tint, dust in the corners, and the macro variation.
- `tile_build`: `tile_material` — Build a tile material: layout, face maps, finish, colour, relief, shading and damage in one node tree.
- `tile_config`: `validate_damage` — Tile material parameters: feature names, the parameter groups that map to node sockets, and the validation rules for each metre or probability value.
- `tile_displacement`: `use_displacement`, `store_displacement`, `use_damage_displacement`, `use_bump` — Tile geometric displacement: switch a tile material between bump shading and true displacement.
- `tile_finish`: `finish_group`, `gate`, `toggle` — Tile finish group: the owned node group that exposes every editable finish parameter, plus the feature switch helpers.
- `tile_glazed`: `glazed_tiles` — Procedural glazed ceramic tiles (Poly Haven has no pool mosaic).
- `tile_maps`: `find_maps`, `image_stats`, `mean_linear`, `resolve_map_size`, `warn_albedo` — Tile face maps: find a face folder's albedo, roughness and height images, measure them in linear light, and resolve their physical size.
- `tile_relief`: `height` — Tile relief height: rounded shoulders, tilt, waviness, lippage and pit relief, in metres.
- `tile_settings`: `read_settings`, `set_param` — Tile settings: read a tile material's settings back from its node tree and change one parameter.
- `tile_shading`: `surface_shader` — Tile shading: coated clay face and grout, mixed by the joint mask, with a world-metre bump field.
- `tile_specks`: `specks` — Iron specks and pinholes on the glaze: clustered, irregular, varied-size dots from a warped Voronoi.
- `tile_uv_node`: `layout_vector`
- `tile_uv_planar`: `planar_uv`
- `tile_uv_polar`: `cylinder_uv`, `annulus_uv`

## `materials.water`

- `ballistic_sheet`: `LaunchLip`, `SheetFlow`, `mean_launch_speed_m_s`, `stream_factor`, `flow_per_width_m2_s`, `launch_speed_m_s`, `fall_speed_m_s`, `speed_after_drop_m_s`, `sheet_thickness_m`, `throw`, `effective_depth`, `carrier_grid`, `landing` — Ballistic carrier of a water sheet thrown off a straight lip (references/materials/water/water-free-falling-film.md §4.1-4.3).
- `falling_film_assembly`: `FallingFilmSetup`, `falling_film` — One entry point: a free-falling water film with its foot, pool ripples, wet-wall proxy and motion blur (references/materials/water/water-free-falling-film.md and the files it links).
- `film_config`: `FilmParams`, `FilmFields` — Film config; falling-film parameters and surfaces.
- `film_fields`: `zones`, `swell_field`, `roll_waves`, `meander`, `ribbon_envelope`, `tear_value` — Carrier-free film layers in along-lip and stretched-depth coordinates (metres).
- `film_fragments`: `FragmentParams`, `edge_drops`, `gap_fill` — Strings and drops inside torn film cells and along their edges.
- `film_surfaces`: `film_surfaces` — Film build; falling-film parameters and surfaces.
- `impact_bubbles`: `bubbles` — Foot bubbles; water impact fields and geometry.
- `impact_config`: `ImpactParams` — Foot config; water impact fields and geometry.
- `impact_crowns`: `crowns` — Foot crowns; water impact fields and geometry.
- `impact_foam`: `foam` — Foot foam; water impact fields and geometry.
- `impact_locations`: `impacts` — Foot impacts; water impact fields and geometry.
- `impact_splash`: `splash` — Foot splash; water impact fields and geometry.
- `mesh_builders`: `from_arrays`, `film_sheet`, `tubes`, `spheroids` — Water meshes: closed sheets, string tubes, drop spheroids and bubble domes.
- `motion_blur`: `fall_speed`, `set_velocity`, `film_velocity`, `falling_velocity`, `enable_motion_blur` — Motion blur for still water: a per-vertex `velocity` attribute (m/s) read by Cycles deformation motion blur (references/materials/water/water-free-falling-film.md §4.9).
- `pool_material`: `pool_water`, `thin_wall_copy` — Pool volume materials and thin-wall copies for open water shells.
- `pool_ripples`: `RippleParams`, `grid`, `height_field`, `slope_stats` — Pool-surface height field around falling water: craters, crowns, rings, wall-parallel fronts, chop (references/materials/water/water-ripple.md).
- `ripple_bump`: `save_height_exr`, `height_range_mm`, `install_bump` — Write ripple heights as EXR images and install their lip-local bump mapping.
- `seeded_noise`: `smoothstep`, `clustered_noise`, `unit_noise` — Smooth, irregular, seeded 1-D noise: the single noise source for the water fields (metres in, [-1, 1] out).
- `water_mesh`: `smooth_flat`, `water_surface` — Water mesh normals and diced top surfaces for native caustics.
- `wet_wall_proxy`: `WetParams`, `wet_mask`, `build_proxy` — Wet-wall proxy behind falling water (references/effects/wet-surfaces.md › Wet extent).
